description: Kerberos key exchange (suite 0x0007): saprfclib's initiator against SAP CommonCryptoLib 8.5 as the GSS acceptor, recorded locally. The acceptor's keytab holds svc@EXAMPLE.COM (password 'svc-password', AES-256), created with 'sapgenpse keytab'; the ticket was built with that key, so no real credential is involved. 'random' lists every random byte string the initiator consumed, in order.
